title: BenchChecker: Assessing the Credibility of Bug-Fixing Benchmarks for LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2610.19447v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise for Automatic Program Repair (APR), existing benchmarks suffer from data contamination, in which test samples appear in training sets, artificially inflating performance. To address this, we propose BenchChecker, a framework compatible with both open-source and closed-source models that supports more credible evaluation by detecting such contamination. Grounded in the observation that persistent patches likely remain in recent repository snapshots used for training, BenchChecker employs a forensics-based two-stage detection process using only textual model outputs together with public repository history. The first stage conducts a repository presence test by probing the model with code prefixes to infer training inclusion; the second stage performs a patch presence test to verify patch persistence via similarity alignment and test-suite verification. Evaluations using StarCoder-15B, StarCod

translated_title: BenchChecker：评估面向大语言模型的缺陷修复基准的可信度
translated_abstract: 尽管大语言模型（LLM）在自动程序修复（APR）方面展现出潜力，但现有基准测试存在数据污染问题，即测试样本出现在训练集中，从而人为地夸大了模型性能。为解决这一问题，我们提出了BenchChecker，这是一个兼容开源与闭源模型的框架，通过检测此类数据污染来支持更可信的评估。基于“持久化补丁很可能仍保留在用于训练的近期仓库快照中”这一观察，BenchChecker采用一种基于取证的两阶段检测流程，仅使用模型的文本输出以及公开的仓库历史。第一阶段通过用代码前缀探测模型来推断其是否被纳入训练，进行仓库存在性测试；第二阶段通过相似性对齐和测试套件验证来确认补丁的持久性，进行补丁存在性测试。使用StarCoder-15B、StarCod（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出BenchChecker框架，通过基于取证的两阶段检测流程（仓库存在性测试与补丁存在性测试）来识别缺陷修复基准中的数据污染问题，从而更可信地评估大语言模型在自动程序修复任务上的真实性能。
en_tdlr: BenchChecker is a framework that detects data contamination in bug-fixing benchmarks for LLMs through a forensics-based two-stage detection process, enabling more credible evaluation of automatic program repair performance.
